verdict.rationale: Perplexity's docs say the Search API returns ranked results with "extracted content" and "extracted page text for your own model". The Agent API also offers a built-in URL fetch tool. However, nothing shows that the returned text is the full page rather than query-relevant excerpts, and the CLI docs describe returning "query-relevant page snippets". Missing for 10: confirmation of full-page (untruncated) text, a markdown output format, response-field or parameter documentation for content extraction, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
